outcome: ISOLATED_OPTICS_WITNESSED — A frozen specimen gained ink continuously through the sampled magnifications while retaining its center. The microscope-zoom intake remains OPEN.

context.method: Hold the actual replay at the 30% playhead. Project the same 406 Being centers at 15 magnifications, from 1× to 128×. Isolate the followed Being and render its experimental optical kernels with the original Goo/Ink shader in Chromium WebGL2 / SwiftShader. Measure the resulting alpha field and its intensity-weighted centroid.

observed.ink_area_measure: Alpha sum in units of fully opaque readout samples. It increased at each sampled magnification from 231.32 to 8119.28.
observed.occupied_samples: 276 at each of the first three magnifications, reaching 8408 at 128×.
observed.centroid: Maximum displacement from the 1× ink centroid was 0.734 readout samples. All 406 world centers had the same digest at all 15 magnifications.

context.scope: The readback measures this isolated specimen and the sampled scales. Portal interaction, fallback presentation and whole-scene frame cost require their own witnesses.
